decisive_items: a submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration of the overlying mucosa
a well-defined, heterogeneous, pre-pyloric mass measuring 6×5 cm with fat attenuation in the antropyloric region
response.rationale: R4 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from both the submucosal lesion and the heterogeneous mass with fat attenuation, which are characteristic of GIST. R5 is the runner-up because it only has support from the mass with fat attenuation, which could also be consistent with a gastric lipoma, but the presence of a submucosal lesion and ulceration of the overlying mucosa makes R4 a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: lack of specific support for peptic ulcer disease beyond symptoms and ulceration of the mucosa
biopsy showed no malignant features, which makes gastric carcinoid less likely
lack of specific support for lipoma beyond fat attenuation in the mass
